other.gamesetprefer_on_floordsc: Use materials on the floor before things in your inventory.
other.gamesetprefer_on_bodydsc: Use materials in your hands/mouth/back before things in your inventory.
other.gamesetprefer_high_qualitydsc: Use items of lower quality, like lower hammering, later.
other.gamesetprefer_low_valuedsc: Use items of higher trading value later.
other.gamesetprefer_low_conditiondsc: Use items with higher condition later.
